changes.title: Verified owner preview preparation
changes.text: Reuse the verified archive-fix APK for source, signing, checksum, screenshot and PDF checks without rebuilding or distributing to testers.

changes.title: Preserve verification and delivery evidence
changes.text: Record exact test results, artifacts, compatibility checks and honest remaining phone and audit limitations.

changes.title: Preserve the private Cleric collection ledger after damaged storage
changes.text: Read intact rows from a damaged local ledger for continuity, but make automatic persistence fail closed so unknown original bytes and filesystem directories are never deleted. An explicit player reset remains the only recovery action allowed to replace damaged ledger contents.

commentary: I preserved every previously reviewed TEST226 delivery path and added a fail-closed correction for the private Cleric collection ledger. The fix does not alter saves, run history, gameplay, scores, RNG, rules, lore content or player opt-out settings.
